tickets.title: Open New Client Account
tickets.text: Use this workflow to collect account-opening requirements, prepare documentation, coordinate signatures, and confirm funding instructions for a new joint taxable account for Nora Thimblefern and Caleb Thimblefern at Velvet Acorn Custody. Verify the requested joint registration, investment objective, tax considerations, and custodian requirements before submitting. The account will be funded from excess cash reserve, and ownership and risk profile information must be collected before paperwork is prepared.

subTasks.title: Gather account opening details
subTasks.text: Collect required joint registration type, ownership details for Nora Thimblefern and Caleb Thimblefern, beneficiary or authorized-party information if applicable, tax identification documentation status, risk profile, and intended funding source (excess cash reserve) using firm-approved intake materials.

subTasks.title: Prepare and review application package
subTasks.text: Complete the Velvet Acorn Custody forms, advisory agreement updates, fee schedule, disclosure delivery record, and any transfer or funding paperwork. Check for missing signatures, inconsistent names, and incomplete suitability information.

subTasks.title: Coordinate signatures and submission
subTasks.text: Send the application package through the approved signature process, track completion, and submit to Velvet Acorn Custody after verifying all required fields are complete.

subTasks.title: Confirm account setup and funding readiness
subTasks.text: Verify that the joint taxable account is established, document the account title and registration, confirm funding or transfer instructions are ready, and notify the advisor that the account is available for investment review.

tickets.evidence: They agreed by 2025-08-05 to start intake for a new joint taxable account funded from excess cash reserve, with ownership and risk profile information to be collected before paperwork is prepared.

tickets.title: Collect Benefits Enrollment Information
tickets.text:
Complete the following placeholders before reviewing benefit enrollment choices:

Employee or participant name: Nora Thimblefern and Caleb Thimblefern
Employer or plan sponsor: Amber Teapot Systems (Nora) and Copper Firefly Works (Caleb)
Enrollment event type: Qualifying life event (marriage)
Coverage effective period: [RELATIVE OR PLAN YEAR PERIOD]
Available medical options: [PLAN OPTIONS]
Available dental and vision options: [PLAN OPTIONS]
Health savings or flexible spending account eligibility: [HSA / FSA DETAILS]
Employer retirement plan election status: Nora has an Amber Teapot Systems 401(k) near $428,000; Caleb has a Copper Firefly Works 401(k) near $154,000
Current contribution percentage or amount: [CURRENT ELECTION]
Proposed contribution percentage or amount: [PROPOSED ELECTION]
Employer match formula: [MATCH DETAILS]
Beneficiary update needed: Yes
Documents to request: Benefits guide, rate sheet, plan summary, beneficiary form
Questions for advisor review: Whether Caleb should move to Nora's medical plan or keep separate coverage
tickets.evidence: Employer benefit elections remain needed by 2025-08-09 because Nora reported the marriage is a qualifying event and the couple has not decided whether Caleb should move to Nora’s medical plan or keep separate coverage.

tickets.title: Financial Plan Review
tickets.text: Document current household intentions for Nora Thimblefern and Caleb Thimblefern, then update beneficiary and transfer-on-death forms on Nora's IRA (near $186,000), Amber Teapot Systems 401(k) (near $428,000), and Velvet Acorn Custody taxable account (near $312,000) to reflect post-marriage designations. A review found these records still list pre-marriage beneficiaries or have no contingent beneficiary.
tickets.evidence: They agreed by 2025-08-15 to document current household intentions before updating beneficiary and transfer-on-death forms, after a review found Nora’s IRA, 401(k), and taxable account records still list pre-marriage beneficiaries or no contingent beneficiary.

tickets.title: Obtain marriage certificate from Nora Thimblefern
tickets.text: Request the marriage certificate from Nora Thimblefern through the secure portal so Velvet Acorn Custody can process name and household registration updates. The certificate has not yet been uploaded.
tickets.evidence: Proof of marriage remains needed by 2025-08-01 because the custodian requires it for certain name and household registration updates, and Nora had not uploaded the certificate through the secure portal.

tickets.title: Financial Plan Review
tickets.text: Refresh the monthly cash flow worksheet for Nora Thimblefern and Caleb Thimblefern using combined household pay (Nora's $146,000 at Amber Teapot Systems and Caleb's $92,000 at Copper Firefly Works) and the six-month essential-expenses reserve target. Incorporate Caleb's remaining graduate school loans (about $18,000) and the townhouse mortgage ($382,000 balance on a $640,000 home) into the unified household plan.
tickets.evidence: They agreed by 2025-08-20 to refresh the monthly cash flow worksheet using combined pay and the reserve target because Caleb’s student loan payment and the townhouse mortgage will now be considered in one household plan.
